## English

### New Features

- Right-click a network device and choose **Disconnect** to end its ADB connections.

### Improvements

- When an IP connection and wireless discovery both reach the same Android device, ADM groups them into one entry. You can find it by either address and give it one name.

### Fixes

- Screen control can now recover when the system H.264 encoder fails on an x86_64 Android device running Android 6.0 or later. ADM switches to **Compatibility encoder** in the same session, with no root access or firmware change. It supports up to 1280 pixels on the long edge and 30 FPS, and is reused when you reopen screen control on the same ADB connection.

## 简体中文

### 新功能

- 右键点击网络设备，选择「断开连接」即可断开它的 ADB 连接。

### 改进

- 通过 IP 地址和无线发现连接同一台设备时，列表只显示一项。用任一连接标识都能找到它，只需备注一次名称。

### 修复

- 修复部分 x86_64 Android 设备因系统 H.264 编码器故障而无法投屏的问题。在 Android 6.0 及以上版本，ADM 会在当前会话中自动切到「兼容编码」，无需 root 或修改固件。兼容模式最高支持长边 1280 像素、30 FPS。在同一 ADB 连接上再次打开投屏时，会直接沿用该模式。
